exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
instructions: Stand tall holding weights with overhand grip against thighs.
Keep soft bend in knees and lock spine in neutral position.
Push hips straight back toward wall behind you.
Lower weights along shins until hamstrings reach full stretch.
Drive hips forward into bar, squeezing glutes hard at top.
Hold dumbbells at sides with tall athletic posture.
Take generous stride forward, bending both knees to 90 degrees.
Keep front knee tracking over middle toes, back knee just above floor.
Drive through front heel to step directly into next lunge.
Maintain upright torso without leaning excessively forward.
exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges

instructions: Plant feet shoulder-width on center of footplate.
Lower sled smoothly until thighs are near chest (approx 90° angle).
Press through heels and mid-foot to drive carriage upward.
Never hyperextend or forcefully lock knees at top.
Keep lower back glued firmly against back pad throughout.
Place balls of feet on block or calf machine platform.
Lower heels deeply to feel full calf muscle stretch.
Push balls of feet down to elevate ankles as high as possible.
Hold peak contraction for 2 full seconds.
Lower with controlled tempo over 3 seconds.

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and chest proud.

Place forearms on floor with elbows directly beneath shoulders.

Tuck tailbone under and contract abdominals as if bracing for a punch.
Keep neck neutral looking at floor between hands.
Hold for prescribed time without letting hips sag or pike.
